Names the dsh web host node.exe PID 42432 as the koffi.node holder; the mapped PE image keeps a kernel file lock until the process exits, so npm's copyfile of the installed file hits EBUSY.

Refresh reloads only the client SPA against the same live host; ordered steps: stop every dsh process (host + session workers), verify no node.exe remains, install, restart with hard refresh; only dsh-related processes targeted.
Bare package name is shorthand for @latest = 0.1.1-rc.2 while alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5; installing it over 0.1.2-alpha.4 is a silent downgrade, not a preserve-or-upgrade; next also points at rc.2.
